title: Correct optimization, wrong objective
caption: The system satisfies every stated objective — latency, uptime, aggregate accuracy — while the unstated constraints (slices, cost, contestability, evidence) carry the harm. The gap is between what was specified and what was needed.

title: Three fairness criteria that can't all hold
caption: Demographic parity, equalized odds and calibration measure different errors. Under unequal base rates with imperfect prediction, satisfying one can violate another — the choice is a policy decision, not an optimization.

title: A duty per stage
caption: Specify the slices and budgets, measure the disaggregated criteria, explain and document the decisions, then operate fairness as loop stability — the duties chain like the rest of the lifecycle.

title: The carbon ledger
caption: 0.16 kg CO₂eq per GPU-hour at the baseline assumptions; at GPT-3 scale, 1,287 MWh exceeds 100 passenger-car-years. Training is one ledger entry — serving at scale dominates the lifecycle.
